title: Implementation barriers

blocks.heading: Implementation barriers
blocks.text: Planning, skills, ethics, finance and continued training affect how resources become development outcomes. These are mechanisms to investigate, not proof that all people in a lower-income country lack effort or integrity.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Planning
blocks.text: Poor planning can mismatch activities, resources and actual needs. An unused facility may result when staffing or access was omitted; checking the need and operating resources can prevent a construction-only response.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Skills
blocks.text: Missing relevant skills can prevent productive equipment or services operating effectively. Recruitment and accessible training can address a documented gap, while more equipment alone may remain idle.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Ethics and transparency
blocks.text: Corruption diverts entrusted decisions or resources for improper benefit; transparency makes decisions and resource use open to scrutiny. Clear records and accountability can help detect diversion, but publishing a budget alone does not ensure effective oversight.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Finance
blocks.text: Insufficient finance can stop feasible inputs or maintenance being obtained. Identify the missing resource and sustainable funding route; borrowing without viable returns can add repayment pressure.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: In-service training
blocks.text: In-service training updates skills during employment. Relevant practice and support can help staff use changed procedures; a one-off certificate without application need not improve performance.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Apply the distinction
blocks.text: Explain the development mechanism in this fictional case: a funded workshop is built but no training or electricity connection is arranged. The separate missing supports prevent installed capacity becoming useful output; construction expenditure alone is not successful implementation.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Connect the ideas
blocks.text: Connect institutions to National Development Plans (2.2), public services and Development (1.1). Separate rules, resources, implementation and outcomes; fictional examples are not allegations about real officials.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
